title: Frontier Technologies
positioning: A case-based module on how governments, institutions, and organizations should respond to the risks and tradeoffs of frontier technologies including AI.
description: Case-based teaching on public risk, regulation, institutional decision-making, and contested technology futures.

title: Public Policy and The Future of Work
positioning: A case-based module on automation, surveillance, credentialing, labour markets, and the political economy of AI-driven workplace change.
description: Case-based teaching on automation, labour markets, workplace surveillance, credentialing, and the politics of technological change.
